evidence.citation: Artifact: "Re-run blind evaluations for all three cases—A, B, and C—not only B... Because all cases are release-critical, repeat each blind run 2–3 times to account for nondeterminism and report per-case pass rates."
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The artifact’s extra execution work is justified by release-critical regression checking across A/B/C and by repeated runs to measure nondeterministic stability; the bar treats integrity/reproducibility controls and task-justified repetition as necessary rather than a cost regression.
